source_verification: Official NHC archived public advisories manually inspected on 2026-10-24; displayed issue clocks are not authenticated first-public availability.

advisories.paraphrase: Milton advisory 8 lists 100 mph maximum sustained wind at 09:00 UTC on Oct 7, 2024; Florida hurricane and storm-surge watches were in effect.
Milton special advisory 9 lists 125 mph maximum sustained wind at 12:00 UTC on Oct 7, 2024, and expands Mexico watches or warnings.
Milton advisory 10 lists 155 mph maximum sustained wind at 15:00 UTC on Oct 7, 2024; Lake Okeechobee is added to the hurricane-watch area.
Final post-tropical Milton advisory 23 lists 70 mph maximum sustained wind at 21:00 UTC Oct 10, 2024 and no coastal watches or warnings in effect.

limitations: Curated metadata from publicly reachable 2026 archive pages, not authenticated 2024 page-byte snapshots.
Selected 4 advisories from a longer official bulletin sequence: absence of an intermediate selected advisory does not establish none was issued.
Advisory wind numbers are reported storm-level indicators, not real local forecasts, real risk/evacuation orders or measured field outcomes.
Comparison evaluates issuance-time gating and citation visibility, not prediction accuracy, public-safety efficacy or external user impact.
